title: Density-Based Fractionation of Soil Organic Matter
author: Veronica Vasilica
materials: Weigh each test tube and record it.
Use a roll-mixer to slowly mill MAOM.

steps.title: Prepare soil suspension
steps.instruction: Add the previously weighed sodium polytungstate (SPT) to the mixing water, then add 25 mL of SPT, and finally add 5.0 g of soil sample to the tube.

substeps.instruction: Add previously weighed SPT to mixing water.

steps.title: Measure solution density
steps.instruction: Measure the density of the resulting SPT‑soil suspension with a densitometer and record the value.

steps.title: Ultrasonicate suspension
steps.instruction: Place the test tube in the ultrasonic bath. Set amplitude to 70 %, pulsation off, and run for the calibrated time (example 7 min 46 s). Keep the sonotrode at a constant insertion depth, avoid contact with the tube, and stop the run if the temperature reaches 60 °C. After sonication rinse the sonotrode first with SPT, then with deionized water, discarding the rinses.

steps.title: Add glass beads
steps.instruction: Weigh approximately 15 glass beads per tube and add them to the ultrasonicated suspension.

steps.title: Perform density separation rounds
steps.instruction: For four successive rounds, balance each test tube, add SPT to bring the total volume to 35 mL, vortex to mix, centrifuge at 4000 rpm for 20 min (rounds I‑III) or 30 min (round IV), and remove the supernatant. In rounds I‑III remove only the superficial floating POM; in round IV remove all supernatant, leaving only MAOM in the tube. Store the POM‑containing supernatant in a Schott bottle and keep the MAOM‑containing tube on ice or at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Add SPT to reach 35 mL total volume.
Centrifuge at 4000 rpm for 20 min (rounds I‑III) or 30 min (round IV).
Remove supernatant: only floating POM for rounds I‑III; all supernatant for round IV.

steps.title: Filter floating POM
steps.instruction: Transfer the collected POM suspension onto a filtration setup equipped with multiple filters and a vacuum pump.

steps.title: Drain and dispose SPT solution
steps.instruction: Allow the SPT solution to drain completely through the filter and dispose of the filtrate according to safety guidelines.

steps.title: Wash POM with deionized water
steps.instruction: Wash the retained POM on the filter with deionized water until the filtrate conductivity reaches ≤15 µS cm⁻¹ (approximately 300 mL of water per sample, depending on the amount of SPT used).

steps.title: Ultrasonicate POM filter in water
steps.instruction: Place the filter with POM into a beaker, cover with deionized water, and ultrasonicate in a low‑frequency ultrasonic bath for a couple of minutes (setup as described).

steps.title: Rinse POM and limit water volume
steps.instruction: Remove the filter and rinse all POM into the beaker. Keep the final water volume below 45 mL so that the sample can be frozen in 50 mL test tubes.

steps.title: Freeze POM and MAOM samples
steps.instruction: Transfer the POM suspension to a 50 mL test tube, close the tube, and freeze it. Also freeze the MAOM‑containing tube after the next washing steps.

steps.title: Wash MAOM until low conductivity
steps.instruction: Add deionized water (≈45 mL) to the MAOM‑containing test tube, vortex to mix, and centrifuge. Repeat the add‑water‑vortex‑centrifuge cycle until the conductivity of the water column after centrifugation is ≤150 µS cm⁻¹. Example rounds: I – 45 mL water, 30 min centrifuge; II – 45 mL, 30 min; III – 45 mL, 40 min; IV – 40 mL, 30 min (stop water removal). Ensure at least 45 mL total volume remains before the final freeze.

substeps.instruction: Measure conductivity of the water column.

steps.title: Freeze MAOM after washing
steps.instruction: When the conductivity criterion is met, retain the water column and freeze the MAOM sample to prevent loss.

steps.title: Freeze‑dry POM and MAOM
steps.instruction: Freeze‑dry both POM and MAOM samples at approximately 30 °C using a rotary vacuum concentrator (e.g., Martin‑Christ RVC 2‑25) with a solvent‑resistant cooling trap.

steps.title: Weigh dry samples and calculate recovery
steps.instruction: Weigh the dry POM and MAOM samples. Subtract the weight of the empty test tube and, for MAOM, also subtract the weight of the glass beads to calculate the recovered organic‑matter mass.

steps.title: Remove glass beads from MAOM
steps.instruction: Remove the glass beads from the MAOM sample (e.g., by decanting or using a magnet if applicable).

steps.title: Mill POM samples
steps.instruction: Place each dry POM sample into a 2 mL round‑bottom Eppendorf tube, add a few small metal beads, and mill with a vibration mill using a micro‑tube adapter. For very small samples, grind manually in an agate mortar to reduce static electricity.
